capabilities: insert a clickable table of contents at the top of the current note
generate a _index.md file listing a folder's notes and subfolders
generate a _Main-Index.md file listing all vault folders
configure heading depth and sort order per feature
update existing TOC and index blocks in place on re-run
disambiguation: Despite the singular name, it also generates _index.md files for folders and a vault-wide _Main-Index.md, not just per-note TOCs.
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents an Obsidian focus quirk: folder index generation uses the parent folder of the open note because the file explorer loses selection when the command palette opens, and offers a workaround.
problem: Obsidian shows headings only in the Outline side pane and offers no static, clickable table of contents inside the note text, nor index files listing a folder's or vault's notes.
summary: Table-of-contents generator that inserts a clickable heading TOC at the top of a note and builds folder and vault index files.
